correctness.rationale: For any integer N≥2, σ²>0 and isotropic α>0, the doubled-angle Gramian gives eigenvalues (N±|P_s(ζ)|)/(2σ²). The telescoping switch identity yields nonantipodal positive root sums of cardinality k or k+1. The referenced Lam–Leung structure excludes any zero for power-of-two N, gives k≥p−1, and classifies equality as an exact regular p-gon, forcing unique equal blocks. The construction gives sufficiency, and monic cyclotomic divisibility for N=2^a p^b classifies all 2^(N/p) words. The positive eigenvalue balance proves all three information-optimality assertions. Exact finite integer checks of all sign schedules N=2..16, explicit constructions to N=75, and Gramian comparisons reproduced, without substituting enumeration for a general proof.
